headline: Selective assistant extraction is a mechanism win, not a readiness signal.

pre_rerun_review.blocker_to_scaling: Cross-type regression and retrieval displacement remain unmeasured because the slice is single-session-assistant only.
pre_rerun_review.next_required_gate: Run a mixed-type regression/noise slice before any heldout_50 scaling.

miss_diagnosis_after_first_slice.1de5cff2: Gold-bearing Veja assistant turn was selected by the gate, but the gold evidence was not retrieved in top-k.
miss_diagnosis_after_first_slice.dc439ea3: Gold-bearing Hoop Dance assistant turn was selected by the gate, but the gold evidence was not retrieved in top-k.
miss_diagnosis_after_first_slice.6ae235be: Gold-bearing refining-process assistant turn was skipped by the gate because generic-advice suppression overrode strong concrete signals.

gate_fix_review.change: Generic-advice suppression now applies only when there is no memory request and concrete_score < 2.
gate_fix_review.expected_impact: Fixes the 6ae235be-class skipped concrete assistant answer; does not address retrieval/top-k misses.

final_rerun.operational: 54/54 durable instances completed, 0 failed, 0 DLQ, queue_after 0/0/0
final_rerun.breadth_caveat: 260/282 assistant turns were extractable after the loosening, so the cross-type displacement/noise risk is larger and must be measured before scaling.

recommended_next_slice: Run a mixed-type regression/noise slice with selective assistant extraction enabled.
Measure non-assistant answer regressions, retrieved-fact displacement, assistant extraction rate, residue, and latency.
Treat remaining assistant misses 1de5cff2 and dc439ea3 as retrieval/top-k problems unless store inspection proves extraction absence.
